Vintage 1960s Barbie Ken Skipper Collection – 1962 Case, Bubble Cut Barbie, Boxed Skipper & Clothing
$495 - 81526

Wonderful original vintage Mattel Barbie collection from the early-to-mid 1960s, including Barbie, Ken, Skipper, a 1962 Barbie wardrobe case, numerous period fashions, hangers, accessories and storage pieces.

This is not a collection of modern reproductions. Several clothing pieces still retain their original Barbie by Mattel, Ken by Mattel, and Skipper ©1963 Mattel Inc. fabric labels.

DOLLS INCLUDED
Early-1960s Bubble Cut Barbie
Classic blonde Bubble Cut hairstyle
Early Barbie face with side-glancing blue eyes

Body marked with the vintage Barbie / ©1958 Mattel markings
Vintage Mattel body
Nice surviving facial paint and hair for her age

Currently shown wearing the vintage Garden Party fashion
Comparable genuine #850 Bubble Cut Barbies have recently sold around $102–$130 depending on condition and accessories.

Vintage Ken
Early Mattel Ken doll
Includes multiple vintage Ken clothing pieces
Several Ken fashions/accessories included in the collection
One patterned shirt is still clearly tagged “Ken T.M. by Mattel”

Vintage Blonde Skipper
Barbie’s Little Sister Skipper
Comes with the vintage yellow Skipper box shown
Red-and-white striped swimsuit
Early straight-leg style
Box has expected age/storage wear
A comparable 1964 #950 blonde Skipper with original box and swimsuit recently sold for $95.

ORIGINAL 1962 BARBIE WARDROBE CASE
Includes the large black glossy Mattel Barbie double wardrobe/carrying case, copyright-dated 1962 on the exterior artwork.
Features:
Double-door wardrobe layout
Separate doll compartment
Hanging rods
Doll retaining strap
Interior storage area
Barbie hangers
Barbie Accessories cardboard storage boxes
Wonderful original early-1960s Barbie graphics

The case itself has normal vintage scuffs, wear and age-related marks. A comparable empty 1962 black wardrobe case recently sold for $49.

CONFIRMED ORIGINAL MATTEL FASHIONS
Several pieces have been positively identified.

Barbie #931 “Garden Party” – 1962–63
White/pink rosebud print dress
Pink-dot fabric
White eyelet center panel
Pink waist detail
Vintage Mattel fashion

Barbie #979 “Friday Nite Date” – early 1960s
Powder-blue corduroy jumper/dress
Felt appliqué detail
Original sewn-in “Barbie © by Mattel” label

Ken #783 “Sport Shorts” – 1961–63
Distinctive olive/tan patterned short-sleeve shirt
Red and blue geometric print
Original sewn-in “Ken T.M. by Mattel” label
Other vintage Ken pieces included
The pattern and outfit correspond to Mattel’s #783 Sport Shorts fashion.
Skipper #1922 “Town Togs” – 1965–66
Collection includes major pieces from this outfit:
Bright green coat with gold-tone buttons
Matching green jumper
Yellow knit top
Original “Skipper ©1963 Mattel, Inc.” label
A complete Town Togs set recently sold for $55.30.

ADDITIONAL CLOTHING & ACCESSORIES
Also included are numerous additional vintage pieces shown in the photos, including:
Barbie dresses

Coral/orange dress
Pale yellow fitted dress
Plaid party dress
Pink formalwear

Knit sweaters
Ken jackets
Ken shirts
Ken pants
Yellow pants

Blue-and-white striped clothing
Plaid clothing
Red accessories
Small purse
Vintage Barbie hangers

Additional clothing and accessories stored inside the wardrobe case
Some pieces are tagged Mattel while others have not yet been positively identified. I am including everything shown rather than separating the collection.

CONDITION
All pieces are approximately 60+ years old and are being sold as a vintage collection.
